Agibot is an always-on personal AI agent that runs on your Mac. It keeps working in the background, even after you close the window. It can send you a morning brief, keep an eye on things and tell you when something changes, and handle tasks on the web for you. Chat with it in the app, on Telegram or on Slack. It remembers what you tell it, learns from your corrections and asks before doing anything risky. Free forever with your own API key.

Launch tags:Mac•Productivity•Artificial Intelligence [...] Hi Product Hunt, I'm Ökte, the maker of Agibot. Most AI assistants only work while you're chatting with them. Close the tab and they stop. I wanted one that keeps going in the background and checks in with me when it matters. That's Agibot: an always-on personal AI agent that runs on your own computer. What it does - Keeps working in the background, even after you close the window - Sends you updates on a schedule, like a morning brief - Keeps an eye on things and only messages you when something changes - Handles tasks on the web for you, and on Mac it can use your apps too - Talks with you in the app, on Telegram or on Slack, in one shared conversation Why you can trust it - It asks before doing anything risky, and you decide what it can do on its own - Your chats and memories are saved [...] it can do on its own - Your chats and memories are saved on your computer - You can see, edit and delete everything it remembers - One click stops everything It gets better as you use it Correct it once, like "keep my briefs to five lines", and it remembers next time. What it costs Free forever with your own API key. Use OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and others, or run a free local model. You pay the AI provider directly, with nothing added on top. Join the waitlist for Mac, with Windows next. I'll be here in the comments all day. What would you hand off to it first?
